University Teaching & Research Funding

Compliance Automation

Automated SFC University Teaching & Research Funding validation checking Further and Higher Education (Scotland) Act 2005 / Further and Higher Education (Scotland) Act 1992 / Scotland Act 1998 / Data Protection Act 2018 against University Teaching & Research Funding statutory and rulebook requirements. No SFC activity proceeds without a signed, auditable compliance record.

Risk Detection & Early Warning

Evidence Synthesis
